mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_type, biz_id, biz_version_id, template_version_id, flowable_instance_id, status, initiator_id, started_at, ended_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, version FROM wf_instance WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} AND biz_version_id = #{bizVersionId} ORDER BY started_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, biz_type, biz_id, biz_version_id, template_version_id, flowable_instance_id, status, initiator_id, started_at, ended_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, version FROM wf_instance WHERE initiator_id = #{initiatorId} ORDER BY started_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
